title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Return Terms and Restocking Fee
content:
**1. Returnable items.** Only an item whose Ridgeline Special Order Services program is returnable may be returned; made-to-measure, cut-to-order, custom-built and fabricated items are never returnable except as damaged or wrong under the receipt inspection and damage claim terms.

**2. Return window.** The return must be made no later than the program's return window, in calendar days after pickup or delivery. Days are counted as calendar days from the completed date as day 0 to the return date; a return on the last day qualifies.

**3. Packaging.** Where the program requires the original packaging, the item must be unused in its original packaging.

**4. Restocking fee.** A restocking fee of the program's restocking fee percentage of the order total, rounded to the cent and never less than the program's minimum restocking fee, is charged as a restocking fee — except when the program waives it for defective or wrong items and the item is returned as defective or wrong, and except where the program admits the ProBuild restocking waiver and the customer's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership is active at a tier whose benefits waive the special order restocking fee.

**5. Settlement.** The order total is reversed as a merchandise return credit and the payments less the restocking fee are refunded under the Ridgeline Special Order Services refund terms; the return takes effect on the customer's own confirmation.

## Time gate

The clock starts at pickup or delivery, shown as the completed date on the special order record; the comparison is that the return date is not later than the window; the last day qualifies.

| Hypothetical completed date 1 June, 30-day window | Day count | Qualifies |
|---|---|---|
| return on 1 July | 30 | yes |
| return on 2 July | 31 | no |

## Restocking figures (hypothetical Catalog Merchandise returns: 15 percent, minimum 10.00)

| Order total | Percentage part | Restocking fee | Refund of a payment in full |
|---|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 | 102.00 |
| 50.00 | 7.50 | 10.00 | 40.00 |
| 120.00, returned as defective | — | none | 120.00 |
| 120.00, member active at a tier with the waiver | — | none | 120.00 |
